## Starter

Feed the starter twice a day with equal weights of flour and water. It is ready when it doubles within six hours.

## Dough

- 500 g bread flour
- 375 g water (75% hydration)
- 100 g active starter
- 10 g salt

Let the dough ferment in bulk for four to five hours at room temperature, with a set of stretch and folds every half hour. Then shape it and proof it overnight in the fridge.

## Baking

Bake in a preheated Dutch oven at 250 °C for 20 minutes with the lid on, then 25 minutes at 230 °C without it.
